name: surajthalange.github.io
description: Portfolio of Suraj Thalange: technical project manager and Moodle developer. Published Moodle plugins, themes and LMS delivery.

paragraphs: Case studies on the Moodle plugins and themes I have published, notes on what a Moodle theme costs in page weight and what the Marketplace plugin review actually checks, and what I do for clients.

This repository holds the generated site only: HTML, CSS, one small JavaScript file and the images. It is served by GitHub Pages straight from the default branch, so every file here is a file the browser receives.

There is no framework and no client-side rendering. The pages are static HTML, the stylesheet is hand-written, and the only JavaScript is a command palette, a scroll reveal and a playable demo of one of the plugins. Nothing is fetched from a third party at run time: the fonts, the icons and the images are all served from this origin.

whatItDoes.text: Case studies on the Moodle plugins and themes I have published, notes on what a Moodle theme costs in page weight and what the Marketplace plugin review actually checks, and what I do for clients.

requirements.text: The screenshots themselves are captured by a script that drives Chrome over the DevTools protocol against a local Moodle, signs in as the right account, puts each page into the state the shot needs, and writes the PNG under the exact name the placeholder already references.

Every shot asserts something about the page before the screenshot is taken — that it is not the login form, not a permissions error, that the transcript has rows — because a capture harness that cannot tell a real page from a login screen will quietly fill a site with pictures of login screens.
